questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki, now a national reference in coverage, is invited to an international congress. What message should he convey?
options: Coverage is a model of solidarity and access to care
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Coverage is a model of solidarity and access to care. Dr. Alami: I am proud of you.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create a foundation to promote dental coverage. What is the main objective?
options: Promote access to care and solidarity
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Promoting access to care and solidarity is essential for the future of the profession. Dr. Mabrouki: I will support this foundation.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must write a reference work on dental coverage. What is the central message?
options: Coverage is an art that combines rigor and humanity
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Coverage is an art that combines rigor and humanity. Dr. Alami: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should she leave?
options: Coverage is in full evolution, full of opportunities
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Coverage is in full evolution, and opportunities are numerous for those who commit. Dr. Mabrouki: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must create a mentoring program in coverage. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Mentoring transmits fundamental skills in coverage. Dr. Alami: I will support this program.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must manage the succession of her coverage practice. What is the best strategy?
options: Progressively prepare the transmission of skills
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Progressive preparation for the transmission of skills is the key to a successful succession. Dr. Mabrouki: I will help you.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must create a coverage charter for dental practices. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Transparency and patient trust are the pillars of any coverage charter. Dr. Alami: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must train future mentors in coverage. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission. Dr. Mabrouki: I will convey this message.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must prepare a testimony on his career in coverage. What is the most striking element?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Patient satisfaction through good coverage is the most striking element. Dr. Alami: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create an alumni association for coverage. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the bond and promote mutual aid
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Mutual aid and the bond are the driving forces of an alumni association in coverage. Dr. Mabrouki: I will support this association.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must write an article on the future of dental coverage. Which trend should be emphasized?
options: Digital innovation serving access to care
The decrease in needs for coverage
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Digital innovation must serve access to care. Dr. Alami: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create a quality label for coverage in practices. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Transparency and patient trust are the fundamental criteria. Dr. Mabrouki: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should he leave?
options: The profession needs enthusiasts of coverage
The profession is of no interest
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: The profession needs enthusiasts of coverage. Dr. Alami: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create an award for young dentists in coverage. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Excellence in coverage is the driving force of the profession's evolution. Dr. Mabrouki: I will support this award.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must write his memoirs. What common thread should be highlighted?
options: The passion for coverage and service to patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: The passion for coverage and service to patients is the common thread of a professional life. Dr. Alami: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create a training center for coverage. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Training must produce coverage professionals. Dr. Mabrouki: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Skills in coverage and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Skills in coverage and the example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave. Dr. Alami: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must write a letter to future dentists about coverage. What message should she convey?
options: Coverage is a fascinating and promising discipline
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Coverage is a fascinating and promising discipline. Dr. Mabrouki: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must create a scholarship for students in coverage. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Supporting deserving students is an investment for the future of coverage. Dr. Alami: I will support this initiative.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must give a closing speech. What note should she leave?
options: Coverage continues to evolve with those who carry it
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Coverage continues to evolve thanks to those who carry it. Dr. Mabrouki: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must hand over his coverage practice. What is the priority?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Transferring the continuity of skills is the most beautiful achievement. Dr. Alami: I agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must create a peer network for young dentists in coverage. What is the objective?
options: Promote mutual aid and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Mutual aid and sharing are essential for young dentists in coverage. Dr. Mabrouki: I will support this network.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki must write a conclusion to his work. What is the final sentence?
options: Coverage is a magnificent human adventure
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki explains: Coverage is a magnificent human adventure. Dr. Alami: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must leave a message for future generations. What is the message?
options: Coverage is a discipline worth experiencing
questions.explanation: Dr. Alami explains: Coverage is a discipline worth experiencing. Dr. Mabrouki: I completely agree.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki, after a life dedicated to coverage, receives a national tribute. Dr. Alami is by his side. What is Dr. Mabrouki's message to young dentists?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mabrouki concludes: Coverage needs passion and dedication to continue evolving. Dr. Alami: I am proud of you.
